description.narrative: The Project has an AIMM rating of Good, based on an AIMM score of 61. On an unadjusted basis (i.e., without likelihood factor), the full potential AIMM score could reach 70. The most significant expected project-level outcome is increased access to climate finance (through green buildings and green affordable housing finance) in South Africa. Beyond the Project, IFC anticipates that its updated systematic engagement at both the sectoral and financial institutions levels, through investments, upstream, and AS, will help scale up climate finance, strengthen green finance standards in the country, and encourage replication by other institutions in the country, thus, contributing towards increased environmental sustainability through the demonstration and capacity building channels.

The proposed project consists of an up to US$250 million senior unsecured loan with a 7-year tenor to FirstRand Bank Limited (FRB or the Bank) to support the expansion of the Banks EDGE-certified (or equivalent green certification acceptable to IFC) green commercial property finance (CPF) and green home loan (home loans) portfolios, in South Africa (the Project). The Project is expected to be supported by the Market Accelerator for Green Construction (MAGC) Program and the IFC-BMWK Scale Up Climate Finance through Greening the Financial Sector (BMWK) Program as described in the Blended Finance section.

name.narrative: FRB is headquartered in Johannesburg, South Africa. The Bank offers a comprehensive range of retail, commercial, corporate, and investment banking services in South Africa through a network of 616 branches, 4,790 ATMs, and via internet and mobile platforms. The Bank has three major divisions, which are separately branded: First National Bank (FNB) for retail and commercial banking, Rand Merchant Bank (RMB) for corporate and investment banking, and WesBank for asset finance business. In addition to its operations in South Africa, the Bank operates through branches in London and Guernsey and has representative offices in Kenya, Angola, Shanghai and New York.
